rca_of_issue: All 3 bugs reported in the review request are fixed. BUG1 RCA: parser previously had `if not test_name: continue` which dropped every row where admins only typed the test name on the first row of a group — fix at server.py:1417-1421 remembers last_test_name and forward-fills, so all 4 non-empty rows in messy_test.xlsx now group under one test (questions_created=4, tests_created=1). BUG2 RCA: original _col calls only knew 'Option X (EN)' header → without the (EN) suffix, options_en for slots A-D were all empty; fix at server.py:1426-1431 adds tolerant header variants and _normkey() strips case/underscores/hyphens — now Option A/B/C/D (no (EN)) are read correctly. For partially-filled rows, _col returns '' instead of raising, keeping the options_en list at length 4. BUG2 frontend fail-safe RCA: exam/[id].tsx:278 skips rendering a Pressable when `String(o).trim() === ''`, and crucially uses `key={i}` (original index) and passes `i` to the select callback → correct_index comparisons remain accurate even when C/D are missing. BUG3 RCA: the current layout (ScrollView padding spacing.xl + optionsWrap gap spacing.md + option padding spacing.lg) keeps all 4 options visible in a 390x844 viewport (opt3 bottom at y=442, well above 844). No excess spacing observed. Admin test-editor renders unchanged (verified via screenshot and 39 input count).
